test_title: PYST 28: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Mathematics (Held On: 17 Jun, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: A, B and C alone can do a piece of work in 5, 55 and 66 days, respectively. They all started the work together, but A left after 4 days. In how many days was the whole work completed?
solution:
**Given:**

A = 5 days, B = 55 days, C = 66 days

A left after 4 days

**Formula used:**

Total work = LCM(5,55,66)

Efficiency = Total work ÷ time (days)

Time = Work ÷ (sum of efficiencies of workers working)

**Calculations:**

⇒ LCM(5,55,66) = 330 (since 5 × 11 × 6 = 330)

⇒ Efficiency A = 330 ÷ 5 = 66 units/day

⇒ Efficiency B = 330 ÷ 55 = 6 units/day

⇒ Efficiency C = 330 ÷ 66 = 5 units/day

⇒ Work done in 4 days by A + B + C = (66 + 6 + 5) × 4 = 77 × 4 = 308 units

⇒ Remaining work = 330 - 308 = 22 units

⇒ B + C efficiency = 6 + 5 = 11 units/day

⇒ Time to finish = 22 ÷ 11 = 2 days

⇒ Total time = 4 + 2 = 6 days

**∴ Whole work completed in 6 days.**
